title: Deepgram API key (unprefixed): one-property twin (length) (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 39 characters vs the 40 the scanner rules and observed samples agree on, beside the same gate and length: 41 characters vs the 40 the scanner rules and observed samples agree on, beside the same gate. Twin of "Deepgram API key (unprefixed): must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of deepgram-api-key-dotenv: length: 39 characters vs the 40 the scanner rules and observed samples agree on, beside the same gate. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
